compiled_state.title: [reconciler/applier]: inbound labels apply regression -> clears local tags + add still not propagating
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
**What**: PR #453 (bug 57b0 inbound labels) is incomplete. Live probe with combined-fixes branch shows:
- T1 outbound add: PASS (68a4 fix worked)
- T2 outbound remove: PASS  
- **T3 inbound add: FAIL** — Jira-side label add does not appear in local tags
- After T1's bidirectional reconciler pass, local tags lost the pre-existing 'labelprobe-...' tag — likely the inbound pass wrote an EDIT event that cleared the tags list
- BONUS: Jira ends up with an extra 'dso-id:jira-dig-5015' label (unexpected — suggests inbound CREATE or repair path wrote a duplicate dso-id)

**Evidence**:
- Probe: /tmp/labels-probe.sh on combined-fixes branch (verify/combined-3-fixes containing #450+#453+#454)
- Output: /private/tmp/claude-502/.../tasks/b331bcrho.output
- stderr: /tmp/labels-stderr-1780033977.log
- Probe ticket: b2e9-2b6c-4ac3-4ea6 ↔ DIG-5015 (cleaned up)

## Suspected Root Cause
1. Inbound labels apply: dispatches a labels EDIT but the diff list may be empty when no add/remove pending; OR reads current_state with stale tags
2. New 'dso-id:jira-dig-5015' label suggests the inbound differ emits a CREATE for an already-bound jira_key (the OPPOSITE direction of bug 1bb2 — outbound created jira-dig-* duplicates; now inbound seems to re-CREATE a jira-dig-* binding tag)

## Affected Files
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py — _apply_inbound_update labels block (~line 700+ in PR #453's diff)

## Verification
Re-run /tmp/labels-probe.sh from combined-fixes branch after fix; expect T1-T4 ALL PASS.
